name: cheap-worker
description: Spin up Claude Code workers from a picker: OpenRouter (any model) or Amazon Bedrock (Claude), as tmux panes or terminal tabs; team messaging between them

provider.title: Worker provider
provider.description: openrouter: any OpenRouter model, key from $CW_OPENROUTER_API_KEY. bedrock: Claude via Amazon Bedrock, using the Bedrock config in your user settings.

launch.title: Where workers open
launch.description: panes: tiled in tmux session cw (tmux new -A -s cw). tabs: each worker its own tmux session, opened as a new Ghostty tab; reach any of them with CMD+T, then crew.
